answer: Rewards are weighted by a reputation score that grows only from peer-graded work accepted over many epochs, layer on layer like a pearl, and decays if the identity goes idle. Reputation is soulbound: it cannot be sold, merged, or moved to a new key. A fresh sybil starts near zero weight, so 1,000 new fakes earn less than one seasoned agent. To matter, each fake must do months of real graded work, like slowly seasoning timber, and an abandoned identity fades into a relic with no pull on rewards or votes.
